title: Study on the interventional effect and molecular mechanism of HSP72 in regulating oxidative stress by watermelon seed peptide RDPEER.
authors: Yan, Ziqi; Chen, Simeng; Juliet Igbokwe, Chidimma; Duan, Yuqing; Hu, Kai; Cai, Meihong; Zhang, Haihui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究西瓜籽肽与HSP72蛋白的分子对接及动力学模拟，但对象为肽-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法部分可借鉴。
abstract: Molecular docking and dynamics simulation techniques were used to analyze the binding capacity and stability of watermelon seed oligopeptides with heat shock protein 72 (HSP72), as well as the signaling pathway and mechanisms through cellular experiments. Computational simulation results indicated these peptides could form stable complexes with HSP72 through hydrogen bonds and other interactions, with the lowest free energy binding to RDPEER (-60.83 kcal/mol). In addition, by reducing HSP72 expression, RDPEER enhanced the expression of nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2), heme oxygenase 1 (HO-1), and superoxide dismutase (SOD). Moreover, RDPEER decreased the levels of Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1) and nuclear factor kappa B subunit p65 (NF-kappaBp65), tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), lipid peroxides (MDA), and reactive oxygen species (ROS), increasing cell survival rate by 20 % compared to control. Therefore, this study demonstrates that watermelon seed peptides regulate the Nrf2/NF-kappaB signaling axis by targeting HSP72, thereby maintaining cellular homeostasis.
abstract_zh: 采用分子对接和动力学模拟技术分析了西瓜籽寡肽与热休克蛋白72（HSP72）的结合能力及稳定性，并通过细胞实验探讨了其信号通路和作用机制。计算模拟结果表明，这些肽可通过氢键及其他相互作用与HSP72形成稳定复合物，其中与RDPEER的最低自由能结合为-60.83 kcal/mol。此外，通过降低HSP72表达，RDPEER增强了核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）、血红素加氧酶1（HO-1）和超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）的表达。同时，RDPEER降低了Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）、核因子κB亚基p65（NF-kappaBp65）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha）、脂质过氧化物（MDA）和活性氧（ROS）的水平，与对照组相比，细胞存活率提高了20%。因此，本研究证明西瓜籽肽通过靶向HSP72调节Nrf2/NF-kappaB信号轴，从而维持细胞稳态。
